title: Villanova vs Notre Dame: Game Preview
author: Matt

notes.text: The preview describes Logan Duncomb and Kwame Evans Jr. as day-to-day. Their participation is not confirmed here.
Matt Hodge is not expected to play while recovering from ACL surgery.
Villanova changed its exhibition starting guards. The proposed opener lineup depends on Evans; it is not a confirmed starting five.

title: Villanova Preview: Cats Versus Irish in the Eternal City Tip-Off
author: Griffin Floyd

notes.text: Floyd reports that Kevin Willard had not committed to whether Kwame Evans Jr. would play.
The report says reserve center Niko Onyekwere did not travel because of a visa issue.
Floyd identifies likely starters and a possible larger role for Abdou Samb. These are expectations, not confirmed minutes or a confirmed lineup.

title: Liberty vs. High Point: Game Preview
author: Jon Manson

notes.text: Manson frames Liberty’s task as limiting High Point’s transition chances and making the Panthers operate in the half court. This is matchup analysis, not a measured pace adjustment.

title: Panther’s Toothsayer: Liberty — A Clash of Identities to Open 2026–27
author: Staff

notes.text: The preview says Jason Rivera-Torres is not expected back for the Liberty opener. This is an independent report, not an official game-day designation.
The preview contrasts Liberty’s patient offense with High Point’s transition opportunities and notes substantial Liberty roster turnover.
Liberty lists six returning players and nine newcomers after graduating eight seniors. The release does not confirm a starting five or minutes allocation.
Liberty lists the opener in Rock Hill, South Carolina. Its midnight Eastern start falls late Sunday in Central Time.

title: Irish vs. Wildcats This Sunday In The Eternal City Tip-off
author: Notre Dame Athletics

notes.text: Notre Dame’s release describes travel to Rome and an arrival-day practice. It does not quantify fatigue or provide an injury-based scoring adjustment.
